history.p: In the September 1871 Edvard Grieg asked Hartmann, if he would accept the dedication of his new work "Foran Sydens Kloster". Hartmann very politely declined for the simple reason, that he himself had spent the summer setting music to exactly the same text from Bjørnson's poem "Arnljot Gelline", which had been published the previous year.
